summary: Frontend-only verification of the new site-wide WhatsAppFloat component and the /project-map InfoCard WhatsApp button. All acceptance criteria from the review request pass. Light regression on map + project navigation OK.
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsAppFloat.jsx is clean and self-contained (~99 lines). useEffect deps array is empty which is correct (session-scoped prompt).

The float button sits at fixed bottom-right z-40 and the landowner dialog (z-50) correctly overlays it — elementFromPoint over the float region returned an element outside [data-testid=whatsapp-float] confirming the dialog covers it.
InfoCard href in ProjectMap.jsx correctly interpolates project.title into the wa.me message (verified 'My Dream Perch' encoded in href).

sessionStorage key 'mdp-wa-prompt-seen' is set BEFORE the auto-hide timer resolves, so refreshes within the same session correctly suppress the prompt (verified via navigation to /projects — no reappear).
The ® character is preserved as %C2%AE in wa.me URLs as expected — brand-intentional per request.
